title: Architecture triage for Sprint 5 (IMP-5)
story: As every Sprint 5 IC I want the contracts reconciled with the code for this sprint's touchpoints so that nobody builds against drift
acceptance: architecture/sprint-5-triage.md lists, for each Sprint 5 touchpoint (GET /intake/sessions/{id}/policy-vehicles, AI output validation errors, tenant regex validation errors on PUT /config, OIDC bearer scheme), what openapi.yaml says vs what the code does today, with file:line citations

openapi.yaml: policy-vehicles documents 404 for both unknown and not-your-policy (same body), PUT /config documents the 422 for an unsafe pattern, and an OIDC securityScheme is added marked x-status: proposed (not applied to any operation)
x-roles are unchanged (the routes snapshot in tests/security is owned by S5-SEC-01); node --test tests/unit/contracts* (or whichever tests validate openapi.yaml) pass
One architecture-hub post per contract change (type contract-change) and one status post summarising the triage
brief: Read org/sprints/sprint-5-draft.md and the Sprint 5 tickets in org/board/tickets/S5-*.json. You own openapi.yaml for the sprint: other tickets post contract-change requests to the architecture hub; read the hub at start and again before you finish and apply any requests that are compatible. Do not change x-roles. Find the tests that validate openapi.yaml with grep -rl openapi.yaml tests/ and run them.
